svg.title: Exact standardized means of exponential samples

cc:Work.dc:title: Exact standardized means of exponential samples
cc:Work.dc:description: For independent Exp(1) samples with sizes 1,5,30, solid lines show transformed Gamma densities of sqrt(n)(sample mean-1). Dashed lines show the standard normal limit.
